description: Curate the agent's own memory into durable project knowledge. Reviews Claude Code auto-memory (MEMORY.md and its topic files) for learnings worth keeping, promotes proven ones into AGENTS.md or .claude/rules/, records a correction as a lesson that persists across sessions, prunes stale or duplicate entries, and turns a recurring fix into a reusable skill. Use whenever the user asks what you have learned or saved about the project, which memories should become permanent rules, to remember a lesson or stop repeating a mistake, or to clean up, audit or check the health of memory.
